newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-HEALY REPLACES GOMARSALL IN ENGLAND TEAM.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-HEALY REPLACES GOMARSALL IN ENGLAND TEAM.

text.p: Austin Healy has replaced Andy Gomarsall at scrum-half for England's final Five Nations' championship match against Wales in Cardiff on Saturday.

Healy was the only change announced on Tuesday to the side who lost 23-20 to France on March 1. Gomarsall has clearly been blamed for his indifferent decision making in the crucial final 20 minutes when France recovered from 20-6 to win an emotional victory.
Healy gave a sparkling display after coming on to the field late in the match against Ireland.

"What Austin has more than anything is sheer pace," England coach Jack Rowell said. "We brought him on against Ireland a couple of matches ago and he settled in very well so we're hoping for good things."

Healy said: "It's been a long time coming and I've been working really hard at Leicester and at (former club) Orrell. It hasn't just started this year. It started last year when Orrell gave me the chance to play scrum-half.
"I played scrum-half all the way through my school days and then I moved to the wing for two years...but I'm a bit too greedy to play on the wing. I need the ball in my hands a bit too often."
Fly-half Paul Grayson has been selected subject to a fitness test with Mike Catt slotted to take his place if a torn hip muscle does not repair in time.

England - Tim Stimpson; Jon Sleightholme, Will Carling, Phil de Glanville (captain), Tony Underwood; Paul Grayson, Austin Healy; Tim Rodber, Lawrence Dallaglio, Richard Hill, Martin Johnson, Simon Shaw, Graham Rowntree, Mark Regan, Jason Leonard.
